name: Firstweeks Pilot Analytics Dashboard
description: Key metrics for Firstweeks postpartum support app pilot with 2 OB-GYN practices and 30 first-time mothers
caveats: Data is de-identified. User IDs are salted SHA-256 hashes. Dates generalized to week/month buckets. Small cell counts (<11) suppressed.

dashboardcards.name: Daily Active Users (DAU)
dashboardcards.description: Number of unique moms completing check-ins each day

native.query:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', c.createdAtWeek) as day, COUNT(DISTINCT c.userIdHash) as dau
FROM firstweeks_analytics.checkins c
WHERE c.export_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 30)
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', c.createdAtWeek)
ORDER BY day DESC

dashboardcards.name: Retention (D1, D7, D30)
dashboardcards.description: Percentage of moms returning at day 1, 7, and 30

native.query:
WITH first_checkin AS (
  SELECT userIdHash, MIN(createdAtWeek) as first_week
  FROM firstweeks_analytics.checkins
  GROUP BY userIdHash
),
returning AS (
  SELECT 
    f.userIdHash,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.weekPostpartum - f.first_week = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.weekPostpartum - f.first_week <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d7,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.weekPostpartum - f.first_week <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d30
  FROM first_checkin f
  JOIN firstweeks_analytics.checkins c ON c.userIdHash = f.userIdHash
  GROUP BY f.userIdHash
)
SELECT 
  AVG(d1) * 100 as retention_d1,
  AVG(d7) * 100 as retention_d7,
  AVG(d30) * 100 as retention_d30
FROM returning

dashboardcards.name: Check-in Completion Rate by Week
dashboardcards.description: Average check-ins per user per week postpartum

native.query:
SELECT 
  c.weekPostpartum,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.userIdHash) as active_moms,
  COUNT(*) as total_checkins,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.userIdHash), 2) as avg_checkins_per_mom
FROM firstweeks_analytics.checkins c
WHERE c.weekPostpartum BETWEEN 0 AND 12
GROUP BY c.weekPostpartum
ORDER BY c.weekPostpartum

dashboardcards.name: Escalation Rate per 100 Moms
dashboardcards.description: Escalations triggered by type, normalized per 100 enrolled moms

native.query:
SELECT 
  e.trigger,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.userIdHash) as escalated_moms,
  COUNT(*) as total_escalations,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT e.userIdHash) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT userIdHash) FROM firstweeks_analytics.users), 1) as rate_per_100
FROM firstweeks_analytics.escalations e
GROUP BY e.trigger
ORDER BY rate_per_100 DESC

dashboardcards.name: Escalation Severity Distribution
dashboardcards.description: Breakdown of escalations by severity level

native.query:
SELECT 
  e.severity,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) as pct
FROM firstweeks_analytics.escalations e
GROUP BY e.severity
ORDER BY 
  CASE e.severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4
  END

dashboardcards.name: Referral Conversion Funnel
dashboardcards.description: Progression from escalation to completed referral

native.query:
SELECT 
  r.status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.userIdHash) as moms_count,
  COUNT(*) as referrals_count
FROM firstweeks_analytics.referrals r
GROUP BY r.status
ORDER BY 
  CASE r.status 
    WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1
    WHEN 'MOM_CONSENTED' THEN 2
    WHEN 'PROVIDER_NOTIFIED' THEN 3
    WHEN 'APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULED' THEN 4
    WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 5
    WHEN 'DECLINED' THEN 6
    WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 7
  END

dashboardcards.name: Mood Trends by Week Postpartum
dashboardcards.description: Average sadness and anxiety scores over time

native.query:
SELECT 
  c.weekPostpartum,
  ROUND(AVG(c.sadness), 2) as avg_sadness,
  ROUND(AVG(c.anxiety), 2) as avg_anxiety,
  ROUND(AVG(c.sleepDisruption), 2) as avg_sleep_disruption
FROM firstweeks_analytics.checkins c
WHERE c.weekPostpartum BETWEEN 0 AND 12
  AND c.sadness IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.weekPostpartum
ORDER BY c.weekPostpartum

dashboardcards.name: Provider Match Quality by Specialty
dashboardcards.description: Referral volume and completion rate by provider specialty

native.query:
SELECT 
  r.providerSpecialty[1] as primary_specialty,
  COUNT(*) as referral_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completed_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as completion_rate
FROM firstweeks_analytics.referrals r
WHERE r.providerSpecialty IS NOT NULL AND CARDINALITY(r.providerSpecialty) > 0
GROUP BY r.providerSpecialty[1]
ORDER BY referral_count DESC

dashboardcards.name: Cohort Demographics
dashboardcards.description: Delivery type and feeding method distribution

native.query:
SELECT 
  u.deliveryType,
  u.feedingMethod,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM firstweeks_analytics.users u
GROUP BY u.deliveryType, u.feedingMethod
ORDER BY count DESC

dashboardcards.name: Risk Flags Prevalence
dashboardcards.description: Percentage of moms with each risk flag

native.query:
SELECT 
  rf as risk_flag,
  COUNT(DISTINCT userIdHash) as moms_with_flag,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT userIdHash) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT userIdHash) FROM firstweeks_analytics.users), 1) as prevalence_pct
FROM firstweeks_analytics.users
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(riskFlags) as t(rf)
GROUP BY rf
ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC
